Group rides in California

127 recurring group rides around California: 106 road, 27 social, 14 mixed. 45 roll on weeknights, 68 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Easy Does It Sunday Ride in Chico — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Marina Ride (Velo Club La Grange) runs junior Varsity moderate, Varsity difficult; the pace varies from 18 to 30 mph.
